title: The chase test must not reach behind the first of the three occurrences
rationale: The entry move a1a3 advances the chariot toward the cannon along the a-file, on which its attack already stood, so it renews nothing and is not itself a chase; the four White moves strictly after the first occurrence at ply 1 each swing the chariot across onto the file the cannon now stands on and renew the chase of that one unprotected piece, completing the violation at the third occurrence. Only moves inside the three-occurrence window are part of the test, and adjudication does not depend on which side happens to be to move when the third occurrence lands. Guarded fork correction P3, which landed at afec5690: before it the engine ruled this position wrongly, and this fixture is what says so.
